strongest_objection: The item type says 'a stranger' and the map holds two without saying so. Prey question, Magic word, Stop-holder, Tourist key, and Peer question are turned by the stranger who arrives as a client or counterparty: the patient, the litigant, the buyer. Confluence chore, Native gripe, Native tolerance, Read sheet, and Kept tell are turned only by the stranger who arrives as hands, on the roster and in the break room; a patient cannot take document review and a new associate is not handed the leaflet. Read from the client side, the type's 'in one move' clause is false for about half the items, and the map's own fork (Peer question against Confluence chore) is partly a shadow of this split rather than a fact about entrances. It is not fatal: every item still names a real key with a real wrong door, and the split is a dimension the fieldwork discovered without naming, not a collapse. It should be made visible in Confluence chore and carried as the seed. Behind it sit three smaller faults: the seriation's second and third tiers are one tier under two names, False friend list claims total reversal for examples that are shifts, and the loop the form_inference relies on is written inside a label rather than drawn as an edge.

items.item: Peer question: the question that asks for a value inside the domain's decision structure, what is the differential, what is the standard of review, what is the cap rate, is it the alternator or the battery, shows that the asker holds the structure and lacks only the number, and is answered as a peer is answered; it must be re-found in every domain and is heard only if it is right, since a near miss is the prey question in costume; it opens the wrong door in that a peer is not taught, because instruction flows to declared novices, and in a competitive domain the peer answer is a competitor's answer, so the stranger who passes buys speed at the price of the domain's teaching.
items.why: Tested against Kept tell, the closest pair since the ledger merged 'hazing question' into Kept tell. Separating case: the real-estate tourist who has learned to ask 'what is the cap rate?' passes Peer question (structure shown, answered as a peer) and is caught by Kept tell when they do not ask about the roof or the vacancy assumption in the rent roll. A peer question is a phrase and so can leak like the tourist key; the kept tell is what cannot be phrased. Distinct.

items.item: Kept tell: the expert's tell that separates the real thing from its imitation is a cost the imitator will not pay or a habit the imitator cannot know to fake, the surgeon watching hands rather than words, the contractor who asks about drainage first, the engineer who reads the error path before the happy path, the sommelier who spits, and the key is to learn the tell before the vocabulary, since vocabulary is what the imitation has; it is the one key the domain re-cuts when copied; it opens the wrong door where the tell has leaked and been priced, the confidence man's textbook, the trained interviewee, the counterfeit with the right stitching, so the imitation carries the tell, natives move to a new one, and the stranger holds last year's key.
items.why: Survives the pairing with Peer question: the peer question is a tell the imitation can carry, the kept tell is the one it cannot, and the map's closing position (re-cut on copy) depends on exactly that difference. Kept.

items.item: False friend list: the words a stranger already owns that reverse inside the domain are a short list that does most of the damage, positive in medicine, conservative in surgery, consideration in contract, sanction in law, theory in science, aggressive in oncology against aggressive in finance, and the key is that the list is short and each reversal total, so a stranger carrying the outside meaning is fluent and wrong in the same sentence; the carried word is the general failure of every key on this map caught at the size of one word; it opens the wrong door where the danger is an orphan rather than a false friend, a native term with no outside referent, a tort, a p-value, which the list cannot catch because there is nothing to reverse.
items.why: The mechanism claims 'each reversal total' but the item's own examples undercut it: consideration in contract and aggressive in oncology against finance are shifts of referent, not reversals, and the stranger is fluent and wrong in the same sentence either way. The homonym that merely points elsewhere is the common case and the more dangerous one, since it passes unnoticed; the item's dichotomy (reversal or orphan) has no place for it. Repair widens the mechanism to a confidently wrong carried meaning, reversal as the worst case, and changes the orphan clause's 'nothing to reverse' to 'nothing to carry' so the wrong door still follows from the mechanism.
items.repair: False friend list: the words a stranger already owns that mean something else inside the domain are a short list that does most of the damage, positive in medicine, conservative in surgery, consideration in contract, sanction in law, theory in science, aggressive in oncology against aggressive in finance, and the key is that the list is short and each carried meaning confidently wrong, at the worst reversed, so a stranger carrying the outside meaning is fluent and wrong in the same sentence; the carried word is the general failure of every key on this map caught at the size of one word; it opens the wrong door where the danger is an orphan rather than a false friend, a native term with no outside referent, a tort, a p-value, which the list cannot catch because there is nothing to carry.

items.item: Confluence chore: the menial task that sits where every flow of the domain crosses, prep in a kitchen, retracting in surgery, document review in a lawsuit, on-call in a service, obituaries in a newsroom, teaches the domain's traffic in one shift because everything passes through it; the key is the task's position in the flow, not its lowliness, which is what it adds to low-chair-advantages; it opens the wrong door where the chore has been outsourced or automated off the confluence, contract dishwashers, e-discovery, so the stranger who takes it learns the outsourced thing and nothing else.
items.why: The only item a client-stranger cannot turn at all; a patient is never given the retractor. The map's type promises 'a stranger' and 'one move', and this is where that promise breaks, so the item should say so in-text rather than leave the reader to discover that half the ring belongs to the stranger who enters as hands.
items.repair: Confluence chore: the menial task that sits where every flow of the domain crosses, prep in a kitchen, retracting in surgery, document review in a lawsuit, on-call in a service, obituaries in a newsroom, teaches the domain's traffic in one shift because everything passes through it; the key is the task's position in the flow, not its lowliness, which is what it adds to low-chair-advantages, and it is held only by the stranger who enters as hands, since a patient or a litigant is never handed the retractor; it opens the wrong door where the chore has been outsourced or automated off the confluence, contract dishwashers, e-discovery, so the stranger who takes it learns the outsourced thing and nothing else.

items.item: Read sheet: the document everyone in the domain actually reads is the one that binds today's action, the judge's standing order and not the code, the handoff sheet and not the textbook, the on-call rota and not the org chart, the drawing's revision log, the prep list, the docket, the build config, and the key is that the read document is the domain's working interface while the taught document is its legitimation; no slot travels, since which document is read is an accident of each domain's day; it opens the wrong door where the read sheet is oral and lives in the foreman's head, or where the domain keeps a public playbook as a decoy and the sheet it reads is the one it would never hand a stranger.
items.why: 'No slot travels' is false. The slot 'what binds today's action, against what is taught' travels exactly as well as Stop-holder's 'whose no ends the matter'; only the answer is local, which is the same condition as Native gripe (reading rule travels, list does not). The seriation places Read sheet in a 'no-slot' tier on the strength of this clause, and the tier is empty once the clause is corrected. Repair states the slot and keeps everything else.
items.repair: Read sheet: the document everyone in the domain actually reads is the one that binds today's action, the judge's standing order and not the code, the handoff sheet and not the textbook, the on-call rota and not the org chart, the drawing's revision log, the prep list, the docket, the build config, and the key is that the read document is the domain's working interface while the taught document is its legitimation; the slot travels as one question, what binds today's action, while the answer is an accident of each domain's day and may not be a document at all; it opens the wrong door where the read sheet is oral and lives in the foreman's head, or where the domain keeps a public playbook as a decoy and the sheet it reads is the one it would never hand a stranger.

neighbor_test.left: Peer question: the question that asks for a value inside the domain's decision structure, what is the differential, what is the standard of review, what is the cap rate, is it the alternator or the battery, shows that the asker holds the structure and lacks only the number, and is answered as a peer is answered; it must be re-found in every domain and is heard only if it is right, since a near miss is the prey question in costume; it opens the wrong door in that a peer is not taught, because instruction flows to declared novices, and in a competitive domain the peer answer is a competitor's answer, so the stranger who passes buys speed at the price of the domain's teaching.
neighbor_test.right: Kept tell: the expert's tell that separates the real thing from its imitation is a cost the imitator will not pay or a habit the imitator cannot know to fake, the surgeon watching hands rather than words, the contractor who asks about drainage first, the engineer who reads the error path before the happy path, the sommelier who spits, and the key is to learn the tell before the vocabulary, since vocabulary is what the imitation has; it is the one key the domain re-cuts when copied; it opens the wrong door where the tell has leaked and been priced, the confidence man's textbook, the trained interviewee, the counterfeit with the right stitching, so the imitation carries the tell, natives move to a new one, and the stranger holds last year's key.
neighbor_test.separating_case: A memorized peer question: the buyer who asks 'what is the cap rate?' holds enough structure to be answered as a peer, and is then caught by the kept tell (never asked about the roof, never asked what vacancy the rent roll assumes). The peer question is a phrase and leaks; the kept tell is a cost or habit and does not. The pair separates, and the separation is what lets Kept tell close the itinerary rather than Peer question.

boundary_case: Native costume: scrubs, the site vest, the right suit, the vocabulary-dense profile. Tempting because it is one move and it opens doors. Out, because it opens doors without orienting: the type requires working orientation, not admission, and the costume is precisely the imitation Kept tell exists to catch; it belongs to status-conversions. The ruling sharpens what 'key' means here: a thing that changes what the stranger can see, not what the domain lets in.

seriation.note: The endpoints are real (Prey question is the one key identical in every lock; Kept tell is the one the lock re-cuts on copy) and the claimed adjacency Hinge distinction → False friend list teaches: a carried value is the wrong door of every item. Two faults. First, the tiers 'form travels, phrase or person local' and 'slot travels, value re-cut' are one tier under two names, since a form is a slot and a phrase is a value; what actually separates Magic word, Switchboard chair, and Native gripe from Stop-holder, Fatal class, and Hinge distinction is whether the key is usable before the local value is known (ask for the senior, sit in the break room) or only after it (a fatal list you do not hold buys nothing), and under that cut Confluence chore moves to the second group. Second, Read sheet's 'no slot' tier rests on a false clause and is empty once repaired; Read sheet belongs beside Native gripe. Neither breaks the itinerary; both are re-labelings of its middle.

edges.why: The label's 'a peer is not handed prep' is a universal that the kitchen stage falsifies: an established chef staging in another kitchen is put on prep precisely so the kitchen can watch hands, which is Kept tell administered as the chore. The fork is real where the chore marks rank (a visiting partner is not given document review) and closes where the chore is the domain's tell. Condition it.
edges.repair_label: If the stranger enters by the peer question, then the confluence chore is closed to them in the same room wherever the chore marks rank, since a visiting partner is not handed document review, and the two entrances are a fork chosen by the first sentence; where the chore is itself the domain's tell, as with the stage in a kitchen, the peer is put on prep precisely to be watched, and the fork closes into one door.

edges.why: True but adjacent: the two items sit side by side on the itinerary and the sequence already shows a dead unit poisoning its precision. Meanwhile form_inference claims a loop Prey question → Tourist key → Kept tell → Tourist key that the graph does not draw; the closing arc (a leaked tell is re-cut, the leaflet stays one tell behind) lives in a subordinate clause of the Tourist key → Kept tell label. With seven edges already, cut this one and draw Kept tell → Tourist key with that clause as its label, so the loop the form is credited with exists in the relations rather than in prose.

modality_problems: False friend list asserts 'each reversal total' while its own examples (consideration, aggressive) are shifts of referent; repaired above.
The Peer question → Confluence chore label states 'a peer is not handed prep' as universal; the kitchen stage is a standing counterexample; repaired above.

gate.checks.form_inference credits the map with a loop through Tourist key and Kept tell that the relations do not contain; the return arc is in a label clause, not an edge. Either draw it (see the cut edge) or trim the claim to the fork, the two dependencies into Hinge distinction, and the Founding wreck conditional, all of which hold.
Tourist key's speculative clause is honestly marked and the item stands without it; no promotion found.
duplication: None at map level. Item-level adjacencies are discriminated in-text and the discriminations hold: Switchboard chair against low-chair-advantages' Bosun's knowledge (the stranger's routing use, not what the chair confers), Native unit against pricing-unit-metamorphoses (the corridor unit, not the priced one), Hinge distinction against hinge-kinds (the cut before advice, not the variable between advices), Native unit's dead-scarcity clause against ghost-leverages (named as such).
best_unresolved_seed: The two strangers. The map's keys split by who can turn them: the client-stranger (patient, litigant, buyer) and the hands-stranger (the new associate, the stagiaire, the junior on the roster), and the domain has a word for each (patient and resident, client and associate, retail and desk). Breath one held 'Word for us' as a reading with no mechanism; the mechanism it lacked is here: the domain's name for you fixes which keys are on your ring, and a stranger who wants the other ring must be renamed first. That is the next list.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted with repairs after finding two strangers (client and hands) under one item type, correcting False friend list's total-reversal claim, conditioning the Peer question/Confluence chore fork on whether the chore is the domain's tell, and cutting the Native unit → Native tolerance edge so the loop the form claims can be drawn as Kept tell → Tourist key.
